# Telegram Media Downloader

> Self-hosted Telegram media downloader with a web dashboard. It downloads and archives photos, videos, documents, voice messages, GIFs, stickers and Stories from Telegram channels, groups and private chats (including private ones you belong to) using your own account over MTProto. Version 3.0 is a single Go binary, tgdl-server, with the dashboard embedded; it runs from the Docker image ghcr.io/botnick/telegram-media-downloader (amd64, arm64) or as a native binary on Linux, Windows and macOS. MIT licensed.

Key facts for 3.0: no Node.js runtime; Telegram via gotd; state in SQLite under TGDL_DATA_DIR (./data); dashboard on port 3000; first password set with `tgdl-server setup --password-stdin`; 2.x installs upgrade in place. Not in 3.0: Google Drive and Dropbox backups, hardware-accelerated thumbnails (FFMPEG_HWACCEL ignored), new face/NSFW/seekbar AI results, auto-forward, self-destructing media capture, automatic disk rotation.

## Code map

- core-service/cmd/tgdl-server: the server plus `setup`, `backup-restore`, `backup-decrypt` and `version` commands
- core-service/internal/app: HTTP and WebSocket routes, authorization, settings, integration
- core-service/internal/accounts, telegram, session: account ownership, gotd sessions, login, Telegram updates
- core-service/internal/engine, download, filepublish: durable queue, ingestion, download-time dedup, streaming SHA-256, atomic publication and recovery
- core-service/internal/store, dbread: SQLite schema, migrations and read projections
- core-service/internal/backup, cluster, rescue: backups and restore, peer pairing and sync, rescue retention
- core-service/internal/webassets/public: browser dashboard (ES modules) embedded in the binary
- Build and test with `make build`, `make test`, `make check`. Historical HTTP/WS contract snapshots are in tests/contract; the removed Node backend is in Git at commit aa83eed. faces-service, nsfw-service and seekbar-service are separate projects not called by the 3.0 server.
